investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC, escalated once to Level 2 STRUCTURAL. A plain curl GET of the venue's own official site's HTML listing/agenda page exposed no per-event JSON-LD or structured cards; inspecting the site's own WordPress REST API surface (/wp-json/wp/v2/types) revealed a custom 'eventos' post type, confirmed public via a plain curl GET (Level 2) — but that REST list's own 'date'/'date_gmt' is only the CMS post-publish timestamp, not the real event date. A plain curl GET of one individual event page then directly exposed the real date/time as visible page text under a 'FECHA'/'HORARIO' heading (a JetEngine dynamic-field widget) — still Level 1/2 static HTML, no JS execution or browser needed to read it.

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of the venue's own agenda/listing pages exposed no JSON-LD Event/MusicEvent blocks and no server-rendered event-card list with a usable per-event date.

Inspecting the site's own public WordPress REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/types) revealed a custom 'eventos' post type; a plain curl GET of /wp-json/wp/v2/eventos returned real, structured records for link discovery and music-relevance filtering (class_list carries 'tipo-de-evento-concierto' on every sampled record). A plain curl GET of one individual event page's own static HTML then directly exposed the real event date/time as visible text — no browser/headless observation was needed at any point.

identity.notes: Official identity confirmed directly from the retained evidence at https://sala-upload.com/.

site_classification.platform: WordPress core REST API (custom 'eventos' post type) for link discovery, combined with a JetEngine/Elementor 'dynamic field' template rendering the real event date/time as static page text.

start_date.notes: The REST API's own 'date'/'date_gmt' is genuinely only the CMS post-publish timestamp (the same documented limitation already found for Marula Café, docs/BARCELONA_VENUE_POPULATION.md) — NOT used as the event date. The real date is this event page's own visible text under a 'FECHA' heading, a full 'D mes YYYY' Spanish string (e.g. '26 septiembre 2026') mechanically parsed via a fixed month-name table (never a guess).

time.notes: The same event page's own visible text under a 'HORARIO' heading, a plain local 'HH:MM' string with no offset — FLOATING_LOCAL, never upgraded to UTC.

venue_location.notes: Not present per-record (this source resolves to ONE physical venue via source_id).

source_record_id.notes: Each REST record's own numeric 'id' (the WordPress post ID) — a stable, source-native identifier.

price.notes: Not present in this source's own REST records or the sampled event page.
